Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class RegulatoryEventAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.RegulatoryEventAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegulatoryEventPort
@Component public class RegulatoryEventAdapter extends Object implements RegulatoryEventPort
JPA-backed implementation of RegulatoryEventPort.

Converts between the immutable RegulatoryEvent domain record and the mutable RegulatoryEventEntity JPA entity. The aiHealthcareKeywords list is stored as a pipe-delimited string.
